name: const unsafe fn assume_init_mut (& mut self) -> & mut T
rule: Before calling `MaybeUninit<T>::assume_init_mut`, the caller must ensure that the contained `T` is fully initialized; calling it on uninitialized or partially initialized contents is undefined behavior, so it must not be used to initialize the value.
